project_owned_material.scope: Project-authored code, documentation, compilation/arrangement, and original human/AI-assisted synthesis to the extent rights are held by the project.

requirements: Quran text must remain verbatim; changing it is not allowed.
Clearly attribute Tanzil Project and link to tanzil.net.
Reproduce the Tanzil notice appropriately in files derived from or containing a substantial portion of the Quran text.

quranic_arabic_corpus.caveat: QAC public pages are not fully internally consistent: the download page states GNU GPL while the FAQ describes research/non-commercial use. This release does not represent QAC-derived fields as cleared for unrestricted commercial reuse.

quran_foundation.note: Raw Quran Foundation/Quran.com API content is not included in publication data. Project-derived transliterations/glosses are separate project metadata.
